guide.summary: Doubling a verb (看看, 休息休息, 散散步) or adding 一下 makes the action short, casual or a try: 'have a look', 'take a little rest'. It only fits actions you can do briefly, so it cannot combine with anything that says ongoing, experienced, finished or how long. Doubling an adjective (大大的, 高高兴兴) makes it vivid and already carries its own degree, so 很 is never added.

subs.label: 看看 / 看一看
subs.focus: One-syllable action verb doubled (看看, 试一试) for a brief or tentative action in suggestions, requests, plans. Learner chooses the doubled form over a blunt bare verb, or builds A一A. Mistake: doubling non-action verbs (知道知道, 有有, 喜欢喜欢).

subs.label: 休息休息 (ABAB)
subs.focus: Two-syllable compound verbs (休息, 学习, 介绍, 讨论, 打扫, 收拾, 锻炼, 复习, 准备, 考虑, 商量) double as ABAB. Learner must reject AABB (休休息息), AAB (休休息) and inserted 一. Classic mistake: copying 看一看 into 休息一休息.

subs.label: 散散步 (AAB)
subs.focus: Verb-object (separable) words double only the verb: 散散步, 聊聊天, 帮帮忙, 见见面, 跑跑步, 睡睡觉, 洗洗澡, 唱唱歌. Learner decides separable (AAB) versus true compound (ABAB). Classic mistake: 散步散步, 聊天聊天, 见面见面.

subs.label: 看了看 (done)
subs.focus: Brief action actually done and narrated: 了 goes between the verbs (看了看, 想了想, 笑了笑), not after the pair (看看了). One-syllable verbs only; two-syllable verbs take 了一下 (休息了一下). Never treat a past plan (昨天想去看看) as needing 了.

subs.label: Verb + 一下
subs.focus: V + 一下 equals doubling and fits any action verb. Learner decides: 一下 right after the verb, before a noun object (看一下这本书); inside a separable verb (帮一下忙); done action is V了一下; never on a doubled verb. Mistakes: 看看一下, 见面一下.

subs.label: Where doubling is impossible
subs.focus: Doubled verb (or V一下) cannot combine with 正在/在, 着, 过, a result complement (完, 到, 懂, 见) or a duration/count. Item shows one of these and forces the bare verb. Use clearly impossible wrong forms: 正在看看, 看看过, 看看完, 听听懂, 等等十分钟.

subs.label: 大大的 (AA的)
subs.focus: One-syllable adjective doubled + 的 for vivid description, as predicate or before a noun (眼睛大大的, 红红的苹果). Learner decides: no 很/非常/太, no 不, and 的 is needed. Mistakes: 很大大的, 眼睛大大 without 的. Use 大 小 高 长 短 胖 瘦 圆 红 白 黑 甜.

subs.label: 高高兴兴 vs 雪白雪白
subs.focus: Two-syllable adjectives: ordinary ones are AABB (高高兴兴, 干干净净, 清清楚楚, 舒舒服服, 认认真真); comparison-type ones (雪白, 冰凉, 通红) are ABAB + 的. No 很. Mistakes: 高兴高兴地, 雪雪白白. Wrong forms must sit before 地, after 得 or with 的: 高兴高兴 exists as a verb.

subs.label: 慢慢地 + verb
subs.focus: Doubled adjective as manner goes before the verb with 地: 慢慢地走, 好好学习, 轻轻地关门. Learner decides position (never after the verb), particle (地, not 的/得) and no 很. Mistakes: 说慢慢地, 很慢慢地说. Never test dropping 地: 慢慢走 and 慢慢地走 are both right.

rules.rule: Double a one-syllable action verb to say 'do it a bit / give it a try'. You can put 一 in the middle with no change in meaning. It softens suggestions and requests.

examples.py: nǐ kàn kan zhè běn shū
examples.en: Have a look at this book.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng shì yī shì nà jiàn yī fu
examples.en: I'd like to try that piece of clothing on.

examples.py: nǐ cháng chang zhè ge cài hěn hǎo chī
examples.en: Have a taste of this dish, it's delicious.

examples.py: zhè ge wèn tí wǒ yào xiǎng xiang
examples.en: I need to think about this question a bit.

rules.note: Only deliberate actions can be doubled this way: not 是, 有, 在, 知道, 喜欢, 觉得. The second verb is pronounced light (kàn kan). In plain statements a doubled verb is not negated (我不看看 is wrong); it does appear after 不 in pushing questions such as 你怎么不问问他?

rules.rule: A two-syllable verb that is one solid word repeats as a whole, ABAB. Never put 一 in the middle and never use AABB.

examples.py: wǒ men xiū xi xiū xi ba
examples.en: Let's take a little rest.

examples.zh: 你给我们介绍介绍你的朋友吧。
examples.py: nǐ gěi wǒ men jiè shào jiè shào nǐ de péng you ba
examples.en: Introduce your friend to us.

examples.zh: 这件事我们明天再讨论讨论。
examples.py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ men míng tiān zài tǎo lùn tǎo lùn
examples.en: Let's discuss this matter a bit more tomorrow.

examples.zh: 周末我想在家打扫打扫房间。
examples.py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng zài jiā dǎ sǎo dǎ sǎo fáng jiān
examples.en: This weekend I want to tidy up my room a bit at home.

rules.rule: If the two-syllable verb is really verb + object (you can put words between the two parts, as in 散了一会儿步), double only the verb: AAB.

examples.zh: 吃完饭，我们去散散步吧。
examples.py: chī wán fàn wǒ men qù sàn san bù ba
examples.en: After we eat, let's go for a little walk.

examples.zh: 周末我喜欢跟朋友聊聊天。
examples.py: zhōu mò wǒ xǐ huan gēn péng you liáo liao tiān
examples.en: On weekends I like to have a chat with friends.

examples.zh: 你有时间的话，我们见见面吧。
examples.py: nǐ yǒu shí jiān de huà wǒ men jiàn jian miàn ba
examples.en: If you have time, let's meet up.

examples.py: qǐng nǐ bāng bang máng
examples.en: Please lend a hand.

rules.note: Test: can you say Verb + 了 / 个 / 一会儿 + second part (见了面, 帮个忙, 睡一会儿觉)? Then it is separable and takes AAB. 休息, 学习, 介绍 fail the test and take ABAB.

rules.rule: For a brief action that was actually done, put 了 between the two verbs. It usually leads on to what happened next.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 了 + Verb + Object, + next event

examples.py: tā kàn le kàn shǒu biǎo jiù zǒu le
examples.en: He glanced at his watch and left.

examples.py: tā xiǎng le xiǎng méi yǒu huí dá
examples.en: She thought for a moment and didn't answer.

examples.zh: 我试了试那双鞋，有点儿小。
examples.py: wǒ shì le shì nà shuāng xié yǒu diǎn r xiǎo
examples.en: I tried those shoes on; they were a bit small.

examples.zh: 老师笑了笑，什么也没说。
examples.py: lǎo shī xiào le xiào shén me yě méi shuō
examples.en: The teacher gave a little smile and said nothing.

rules.note: V了V is natural with one-syllable verbs. With two-syllable verbs, 休息了休息 is possible but uncommon; say 休息了一下. A past plan or wish needs no 了: 昨天我想去看看他.

rules.rule: Verb + 一下 means the same as doubling and is always safe, also with two-syllable verbs. 一下 comes straight after the verb, before a noun object.

examples.py: qǐng děng yī xià
examples.en: Please wait a moment.

examples.py: nǐ kàn yī xià zhè ge jù zi
examples.en: Take a look at this sentence.

examples.zh: 我来介绍一下，这是小王。
examples.py: wǒ lái jiè shào yī xià zhè shì xiǎo wáng
examples.en: Let me make an introduction: this is Xiao Wang.

examples.py: wǒ gāng cái wèn le yī xià lǎo shī
examples.en: I just asked the teacher.

rules.note: With a pronoun object both orders are used: 等我一下 is the more common, 等一下我 is also said. Do not build items that depend on this choice.

rules.rule: Choose one softener: doubling or 一下, never both. With a separable verb, 一下 goes inside the word, like any other inserted element.

examples.py: nǐ néng bāng yī xià máng ma
examples.en: Could you lend a hand?

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ jiàn yī xià miàn
examples.en: I'd like to meet with you briefly.

examples.py: wǒ men xiū xi yī xià ba
examples.en: Let's take a short break.

rules.note: 休息一下 is fine because 休息 is not separable. Forms like 帮忙一下 are heard in some regions but are not standard mainland usage.

rules.rule: No doubling and no 一下 for an action that is in progress, continuing, or an experience: with 正在 / 在, 着 or 过 use the bare verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 正在 + Verb + Object / Verb + 过 + Object

examples.py: wǒ zhèng zài tīng yīn yuè
examples.en: I'm listening to music right now.

examples.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn guo
examples.en: I've read this book.

examples.py: tā zài fáng jiān lǐ xiū xi ne
examples.en: He's resting in his room.

rules.rule: No doubling when the sentence already says how the action ends or how long it lasts: with a result complement, a duration or a count, use the bare verb.

examples.py: zuò yè wǒ yǐ jīng xiě wán le
examples.en: I've already finished my homework.

examples.py: nǐ děng wǒ shí fēn zhōng ba
examples.en: Wait ten minutes for me.

examples.py: wǒ men xiū xi yī huì r ba
examples.en: Let's rest for a while.

examples.zh: 我想看完这本书再睡觉。
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng kàn wán zhè běn shū zài shuì jiào
examples.en: I want to finish this book before going to sleep.

rules.note: Doubling already means 'for a short while', so a second measure of time or a result clashes with it. Colloquial 看看清楚 or 洗洗干净 can be heard in some regions; do not use these in items, and do not mark them as the standard form.

rules.rule: Double a one-syllable adjective and add 的 to paint a picture. The doubled form already carries its own degree: no 很, 非常, 太 and no 不 in front.
rules.pattern: Noun + AA + 的 / AA + 的 + Noun

examples.py: tā de yǎn jing dà dà de
examples.en: She has big, big eyes.

examples.zh: 他个子高高的，头发短短的。
examples.py: tā gè zi gāo gāo de tóu fa duǎn duǎn de
examples.en: He's nice and tall, with short hair.

examples.zh: 桌子上有一个红红的苹果。
examples.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè hóng hóng de píng guǒ
examples.en: There's a bright red apple on the table.

rules.note: The doubled form describes; it does not compare or measure. For 'very big' as a plain statement of degree, use 很大 instead, not both.

rules.rule: An ordinary two-syllable adjective doubles each syllable: AABB. No 很 in front.
rules.pattern: AABB + 地 + Verb / Verb + 得 + AABB + 的

examples.zh: 孩子们高高兴兴地回家了。
examples.py: hái zi men gāo gāo xìng xìng de huí jiā le
examples.en: The children went home happily.

examples.zh: 她把房间打扫得干干净净的。
examples.py: tā bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng de
examples.en: She cleaned the room until it was spotless.

examples.zh: 黑板上的字写得清清楚楚。
examples.py: hēi bǎn shàng de zì xiě de qīng qīng chǔ chǔ
examples.en: The characters on the blackboard are written very clearly.

rules.note: Not every adjective can do this (no 容容易易, 重重要要). Safe ones: 高兴, 干净, 漂亮, 清楚, 舒服, 认真, 安静, 简单, 开心, 整齐. 高兴高兴 does exist, but as a verb: 让大家高兴高兴 'cheer everyone up a bit'.

rules.rule: If the first syllable is a comparison ('white as snow', 'cold as ice'), repeat the whole word: ABAB + 的. These words already mean 'extremely', so 很 is impossible even without doubling.

examples.py: tā de chèn shān xuě bái xuě bái de
examples.en: Her shirt is snow-white.

examples.py: tā de shǒu bīng liáng bīng liáng de
examples.en: His hands are ice-cold.

examples.zh: 孩子的脸冻得通红通红的。
examples.py: hái zi de liǎn dòng de tōng hóng tōng hóng de
examples.en: The child's face is bright red from the cold.

rules.rule: To say how an action is done, put the doubled adjective before the verb, linked with 地. It never goes after the verb and never takes 很.

examples.py: bié zháo jí màn màn de shuō
examples.en: Don't worry, say it slowly.

examples.py: tā qīng qīng de guān shàng le mén
examples.en: He gently closed the door.

examples.py: nǐ yào hǎo hǎo xué xí
examples.en: You need to study properly.

examples.zh: 我们认认真真地准备了一个星期。
examples.py: wǒ men rèn rèn zhēn zhēn de zhǔn bèi le yī gè xīng qī
examples.en: We prepared conscientiously for a week.

rules.note: After a one-syllable doubled form 地 is often dropped (慢慢走, 好好休息); 好好 usually goes without it. AABB forms normally keep 地. In informal writing people often type 的 for 地; the standard written form is 地.

right.py: wǒ men xiū xi xiū xi ba

contrasts.why: 一 can only go between the two halves of a doubled one-syllable verb (看一看). A two-syllable verb is simply ABAB, or use 休息一下.

contrasts.wrong: 吃完饭，我们去散步散步吧。

right.zh: 吃完饭，我们去散散步吧。
right.py: chī wán fàn wǒ men qù sàn san bù ba
right.en: After we eat, let's go for a little walk.

contrasts.why: 散步 is verb + object (散 + 步), so only the verb 散 is doubled: AAB, not ABAB.

right.py: tā kàn le kàn shǒu biǎo jiù zǒu le
right.en: He glanced at his watch and left.

contrasts.why: For a brief action that was done, 了 sits between the two verbs, not after the pair.

right.py: nǐ kàn yī xià zhè ge jù zi
right.en: Take a look at this sentence.

contrasts.why: Doubling and 一下 do the same job. Use one of them: 看看 or 看一下, never both together.

right.py: wǒ zhèng zài kàn diàn shì

contrasts.why: A doubled verb means a short, casual go at something; it cannot describe an action in progress, so 正在 takes the bare verb.

contrasts.wrong: 我想看看完这本书再睡觉。

right.zh: 我想看完这本书再睡觉。
right.py: wǒ xiǎng kàn wán zhè běn shū zài shuì jiào
right.en: I want to finish this book before going to sleep.

contrasts.why: A result complement (完) says the action reaches its end; doubling says 'just a bit'. They cannot combine.

right.py: nǐ děng wǒ shí fēn zhōng ba

contrasts.why: Doubling already means 'for a short time', so it cannot take a stated duration. With 十分钟 use the bare verb.

right.py: tā de yǎn jing dà dà de

contrasts.why: A doubled adjective has its degree built in. Say 大大的 or 很大, never 很 + doubled form.

contrasts.wrong: 孩子们高兴高兴地回家了。

right.zh: 孩子们高高兴兴地回家了。
right.py: hái zi men gāo gāo xìng xìng de huí jiā le

contrasts.why: A two-syllable adjective doubles as AABB. ABAB is the verb pattern (休息休息), not the pattern for describing how someone does something.

right.py: bié zháo jí màn màn de shuō

contrasts.why: A manner word with 地 goes before the verb. English puts 'slowly' after the verb; Chinese does not.

cheat: One-syllable verb: 看看 or 看一看. Two-syllable verb: 休息休息, never with 一 in the middle.
Can the word be split (散了一会儿步)? Then double only the verb: 散散步, 聊聊天, 见见面.
Already done? 了 goes in the middle: 看了看. Two syllables: 休息了一下.
一下 or doubling, never both: 看看 or 看一下, not 看看一下.
See 正在, 着, 过, a result (完, 到, 懂) or a time amount? Bare verb, no doubling, no 一下.
Doubled adjective: no 很, add 的. 大大的, 高高兴兴, 雪白雪白的.
Manner goes before the verb with 地: 慢慢地说, 好好学习.
